feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 September 2026 12:05pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 02 September 2026 at 11:55am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at times.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the north and west of Britain, with various fronts affecting the Irish Sea at times over the next few days.


##Wind##

South or Southeast 5 at first, possibly occasionally 6, veering South or Southwest 4 or 5 this afternoon or early evening, then veering West or Southwest tonight and increasing 5 occasionally 6. Decreasing Southwest 4 or 5 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain and drizzle at first, risk of mist patches, then becoming fair later today.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor at first, but improving good later today.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 at times later tomorrow, then veering West 5 or 6 overnight into Friday.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Rain for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.
